data.name: Wadeem Gardens
overview: Wadeem Gardens by Modon Properties is a villa community on Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi, offering spacious **4, 5, and 6-bedroom homes** in three gated clusters. Designed around everyday convenience, the district brings education, wellness, retail, dining, entertainment, and waterfront experiences together, supported by clubhouses, international schools, cinemas, and a waterfront promenade.

Wadeem Gardens on Hudayriyat Island combines private villa living with a connected community setting shaped by Contemporary Arabic and Modernist architecture. Its integrated amenities, island location, and broader community planning create strong long-term appeal for buyers seeking lifestyle value alongside the potential for high capital appreciation in Abu Dhabi.

highlights.title: Hudayriyat Island Location
highlights.text: Positioned within Hudayriyat Island, placing residents in one of Abu Dhabi’s expanding lifestyle destinations.

highlights.title: Spacious Villa Collection
highlights.text: Choose from 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas designed for generous family living and privacy.

highlights.title: Distinct Architectural Styles
highlights.text: Contemporary Arabic and Modernist façades give homeowners a choice of distinctive residential designs and layouts.

highlights.title: Integrated Lifestyle District
highlights.text: Homes connect with education, wellness, entertainment, retail, dining, healthcare, and workplaces within the wider community.

highlights.title: Extensive Community Amenities
highlights.text: Six clubhouses, international schools, cinemas, healthcare facilities, an arena, and waterfront spaces support everyday convenience.

highlights.title: Modon Development
highlights.text: Developed by Modon as part of a connected Hudayriyat district combining homes, work, learning, and leisure.

highlights.title: Flexible 25/75 Payment Structure
highlights.text: Buyers secure their villa with a 5% down payment, with 75% of the purchase price due at handover.

highlights.title: Capital Appreciation Potential
highlights.text: Island positioning, integrated amenities, and large-scale community planning strengthen the project’s long-term investment appeal.

data.amenitiesIntro: Wadeem Gardens offers an exceptional array of world-class amenities designed to enhance every aspect of modern living.
data.paymentNote: Starting Price AED 8.7M. Handover 2031. Payment plans: 25/75.
locationText: Modon Wadeem Gardens Abu Dhabi is located on Hudayriyat Island, forming part of a connected district that brings residential, educational, wellness, retail, entertainment, and community spaces together. Its island setting provides residents with convenient access to Abu Dhabi’s key destinations while maintaining a lifestyle centred around community facilities and waterfront experiences.
data.investmentIntro: This off-plan project presents strong investment potential across the UAE, with projected rental yields of 6–8%, long-term capital appreciation, and growing demand from both residents and international investors.
marketContext: UAE off-plan properties continue to attract strong local and international investor demand.
Selected communities may offer rental yields of around 6–8%, depending on location and unit type.
Buyers may benefit from 10–15% potential price growth by handover in high-demand areas.
Properties from AED 2 million may qualify for UAE Golden Visa eligibility, subject to regulations.
data.developerText: Modon Properties is an Abu Dhabi-based developer operating within Modon Holding, an ADX-listed group with interests spanning real estate, hospitality, asset management, tourism and related sectors. Modon Abu Dhabi develops large-scale destinations designed around residential, leisure and commercial experiences.

faqs.question: What are the floor plans available at Wadeem Gardens?
faqs.answer: Wadeem Gardens offers 4-bedroom villas of 5,726 sq. ft., 5-bedroom villas of 6,781 sq. ft., and 6-bedroom villas of 7,750 sq. ft.

faqs.question: What is the starting price of Wadeem Gardens villas?
faqs.answer: The starting price for a Wadeem Gardens villa for sale is AED 8.7M.

faqs.question: What villa types are available in Wadeem Gardens?
faqs.answer: Wadeem Gardens offers spacious 4, 5, and 6-bedroom villas, with varied layouts and Contemporary Arabic or Modernist façades.

faqs.question: How can I buy Wadeem Gardens villas for sale?
faqs.answer: To buy a villa in Wadeem Gardens, review our current project listings to compare available properties, and contact our experts for guidance throughout the purchase process.

faqs.question: Is Wadeem Gardens a freehold development?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wadeem Gardens freehold villas are available to buyers of all nationalities with full ownership rights.

faqs.question: Is Wadeem Gardens a gated community?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Wadeem Gardens gated community comprises secure villa clusters and provides residents with 24-hour security.

faqs.question: What is the payment plan for Wadeem Gardens?
faqs.answer: The Wadeem Gardens payment plan is structured as 25/75, beginning with a 5% down payment and concluding with 75% on handover.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Wadeem Gardens?
faqs.answer: Wadeem Gardens amenities include a 2.3 km spine, six clubhouses, an arena, healthcare centres, schools, cinemas, retail, dining, and a waterfront promenade.

faqs.question: Are the villas directly on the waterfront?
faqs.answer: No. The villas are not directly on the waterfront, but waterfront promenades are within walking distance of every home.
